# Setup

This document contains the targets definitions for data processing.

Do data exploration in other documents, then when data processing is
clear, copy it into here.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(targets)
library(tarchetypes)
library(geotargets)
```

# Globals

```{targets globals, tar_globals = TRUE}
options(tidyverse.quiet = TRUE)
tar_option_set(
  packages = c(
    "tarchetypes",
    "tidyverse",
    "terra",
    "tidyterra",
    "geotargets",
    "sf",
    "sfheaders",
    "gdalUtilities"
  )
)
tar_source()
```

# Layers

## State Outlines

```{targets state_outlines}
tar_terra_vect(
  state_outlines,
  map_data("state", region = c(
      "Connecticut", "Massachusetts", "Rhode Island", "New Hampshire", "Vermont"
    )) |>
    sfheaders::sf_polygon(
      obj = _,
      x = "long",
      y = "lat",
      polygon_id = "group"
    ) |>
    sf::`st_crs<-`(sf::st_crs("epsg:4326")) |>
    terra::vect()
)
```

```{targets ma_outline}
tar_terra_vect(
  ma_outline,
  state_outlines |>
    filter(group == 3)
)

```

## Town Outlines

```{targets ma_towns_file}
tar_file(
  ma_towns_file,
  file.path("data/raw/MA_CENSUS2020TOWNS_SHP.zip")
)
```

```{targets ma_towns}
tar_terra_vect(
  ma_towns,
  terra::vect(file.path(
    "/vsizip",
    ma_towns_file,
    "CENSUS2020TOWNS_POLY.shp"
  ))
)
```
## NEON AOP HARV

NEON flies over Harvard Forest, and much more.
The flightbox is our region of interest.

```{targets neon_aop_harv_file}
tar_file(
  neon_aop_harv_file,
  file.path("data/raw/NEON_AOP_flightBoxes_0.zip")
)
```

```{targets neon_aop_harv}
tar_terra_vect(
  neon_aop_harv,
  terra::vect(file.path(
     "/vsizip",
     neon_aop_harv_file,
     "AOP_flightBoxes",
     "AOP_flightboxesAllSites.shp"
  )) |>
    filter(siteID == "HARV") |>
    filter(priority == 1)
)
```

For zoom levels, see:
https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Zoom_levels

0. Whole World
5. Country
10. Metropolitan Area
15. Small Road
20. Mid-Size Building

```{targets basemap}
tar_terra_rast(
  basemap,
  {
    neon_aop_harv_xlim <- c(ext(neon_aop_harv)$xmin - 0.015, ext(neon_aop_harv)$xmax + 0.015)
    neon_aop_harv_ylim <- c(ext(neon_aop_harv)$ymin - 0.015, ext(neon_aop_harv)$ymax + 0.015)
    basemap_area <- terra::ext(
      neon_aop_harv_xlim["xmin"],
      neon_aop_harv_xlim["xmax"],
      neon_aop_harv_ylim["ymin"],
      neon_aop_harv_ylim["ymax"]
    ) |>
      terra::vect(crs = crs("epsg:4326"))
    
    neon_aop_web <- basemap_area |>
      terra::project(crs("epsg:3857")) |> # use webmercator
      st_as_sf()
    
    maptiles::get_tiles(
      neon_aop_web,
      provider = "CartoDB.VoyagerNoLabels",
      zoom = 8, # US County
      crop = TRUE
    )
  }
)
```

```{targets basemap_detail}
tar_terra_rast(
  basemap_detail,
  {
    detail_area <- terra::ext(-72.20, -72.15, 42.50, 42.55) |>
      terra::vect(crs = crs("epsg:4326"))
    detail_xlim <- c(ext(detail_area)$xmin, ext(detail_area)$xmax)
    detail_ylim <- c(ext(detail_area)$ymin, ext(detail_area)$ymax)
    
    detail_area_web <- detail_area |>
      terra::project(crs("epsg:3857")) |> # use webmercator
      st_as_sf()
  
    maptiles::get_tiles(
      detail_area_web,
      provider = "OpenStreetMap",
      zoom = 13, # village
      crop =TRUE
    )
  }
)
```

## Rope Plots

```{targets rope_plots_file}
tar_file(
  rope_plots_file,
  file.path("data/raw/Rope Plots Data Entry.xls")
)
```

```{targets rope_plots}
tar_terra_vect(
  rope_plots,
  readxl::read_xls(
    rope_plots_file,
    sheet = "Rope Plot Sites"
  ) |>
    mutate(
      lat = as.numeric(gsub("^N ?([^°]+)°.*$", "\\1", GPS)),
      lon = -as.numeric(gsub("^.*W ?([^°]+)°$", "\\1", GPS))
    ) |>
    terra::vect()
)
```

## NLCD

The NLCD available from the MRLC viewer is much higher resolution than
the NLCD available from EarthExplorer.

* MRLC Viewer: https://www.mrlc.gov/viewer/
* Earth Explorer: https://earthexplorer.usgs.gov

MRLC generates a zipfile with the UUIDs both in the name of the
zipfile and in the names of the files contained therein. The UUID
is the identity of the job used to create the file.

Nik's Downloads:

* bddf54a4-322c-40a1-bf88-b050f871fad8: 2024
* c1a704ee-7eb3-47cc-ba90-39e87f9ee635: 1985 - 2024

```{targets nlcd_uuid}
tar_target(
  nlcd_uuid,
  "c1a704ee-7eb3-47cc-ba90-39e87f9ee635"
)
```

```{targets nlcd_file}
tar_file(
  nlcd_file,
  {
    file.path(
      "data/raw",
      paste0("NLCD_", nlcd_uuid, ".zip")
    )
  }
)
```

```{targets nlcd}
tar_terra_rast(
  nlcd,
  {
    nlcd_year <- 2024
    terra::rast(
      file.path(
        "/vsizip",
        nlcd_file,
        paste0("Annual_NLCD_LndCov_", nlcd_year, "_CU_C1V1_", nlcd_uuid, ".tiff")
      )
    )
  }
)
```
